answer: The prism escrow is released only against a juniper receipt, and the voyage audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 67 aliases means carrying 24 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 35 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 13 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
